title: Fur Friends ⚔️ Battle Edition Day 26 | The Artisan Forge | Cozy Kawaii RPG Animation & Lofi
description:
The party flies the new airship to a mountain forge, where Mimi the Artificer is hammering away. Mimi joins, a Rune Hammer cools down the Lava Golem, and everyone's gear gets a sparkly upgrade.

0:00 Arriving at the Forge
0:45 Mimi the Artificer
1:30 The Lava Golem
2:15 Gear Upgrades

⚔️ Fur Friends: Battle Edition — the Fur Friends are adventuring in Pawlandia Online, a cozy fantasy MMORPG world. A new friend joins every episode!
🐾 No one gets hurt: bonked monsters just get dizzy, then become friends.
🎧 Best with headphones. Original lofi music & cozy fantasy sounds.
